title: Longer Trip Charging Planning
summary: The topic centers on difficulty planning longer BEV trips because charging stops add time and create uncertainty about reaching the next station.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes longer trips as hard to plan, especially when the second leg cannot be pre-planned around charging needs.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention worry about reaching a charging station and note that charging stops can add substantial time to each trip leg.

limitations: The sample is very small, with only a few fragments available for this topic.
Most available examples are undetermined, which limits confidence about overall sentiment.
The fragments are narrowly focused on trip planning and charging-stop timing, so broader long-distance driving experiences are not shown.
